name: @scalebrowser/mcp

tools.name: lease_profile
tools.description: Reserve a free profile, start its browser, bind a tab, and return the handle.

tools.name: lease_fleet
tools.description: The same for several profiles at once, one handle each.

tools.name: lease_renew
tools.description: Push the reservation's deadline out without losing the handle.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Say in one sentence what this stretch of work is for, so the operator sees it.

tools.name: release_profile
tools.description: End the reservation and stop the browser. Records how the work went.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigate to a public http or https address, and get the full page map back.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: What is on the page now. A diff, unless you ask for a full map.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element, optionally a point inside it, for a picture rather than a control.

tools.name: press_and_hold
tools.description: The whole press-and-hold gesture, in one call.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Click a field and type into it at this profile's own cadence.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Several fields in one call.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: A key, including modifier chords.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: A real wheel gesture with momentum, not a jump.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text or an element to appear, to go, or for the page to go quiet.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the page or one element, for when the text map cannot describe it.

tools.name: record
tools.description: Start or stop recording what the browser is doing.

tools.name: video
tools.description: Turn a recording into a film, and check on one that is rendering.

tools.name: read_value
tools.description: Read one thing from an element: text, an allowed attribute, a count, a table.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Read the page's prose verbatim, for an article or a thread of comments.

tools.name: interruption_respond
tools.description: Answer what the browser itself is asking: a permission prompt, a device chooser.

tools.name: secret_list
tools.description: Which values this profile holds that the agent may use but not read.

tools.name: interact
tools.description: Hover, drag, upload a file, or choose from a native dropdown.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: History and tabs, including the popup a click just opened.

tools.name: measure_frames
tools.description: How a moving element behaves over time, for a slider or an animation.

tools.name: measure_gap
tools.description: The distance between two elements, for a puzzle piece and its slot.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Turn an audio challenge into text, through the operator's own command.

tools.name: measure_rotation
tools.description: How far an image is turned, for a rotation challenge.

tools.name: interruption_list
tools.description: What the browser is currently asking, if anything.

tools.name: passkey_list
tools.description: Which sites this profile can sign in to without a password.

tools.name: passkey_retire
tools.description: Stop this profile from offering one passkey, for good.

tools.name: cookie_list
tools.description: The shape of the cookie jar. Never a value.

tools.name: cookie_delete
tools.description: Remove one cookie, or every cookie of one site.

tools.name: page_report
tools.description: Console messages and a request summary. Never headers, cookies or bodies.

tools.name: clipboard
tools.description: Read or write the clipboard of the bound tab.

tools.name: save_pdf
tools.description: Save the current page as a PDF artifact.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Follow a download and keep the result as an artifact.

tools.name: artifact_list
tools.description: What this profile has produced: screenshots, downloads, PDFs, recordings.

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: This profile's earlier runs, so an agent can see what was already tried.

tools.name: profile.list
tools.description: The profiles on this daemon, with their state.

tools.name: profile.create
tools.description: Create a profile with a fresh identity.

tools.name: profile.start
tools.description: Start a profile's browser. Does not give you one you can drive.

tools.name: profile.stop
tools.description: Stop a profile's browser.

tools.name: profile.update
tools.description: Change a profile's settings: name, proxy, group, geo mode.

tools.name: input.humanize
tools.description: Dispatch one humanized gesture at a coordinate, outside the page map.

tools.name: session.export
tools.description: A profile's session as a password-encrypted bundle.

tools.name: session.import
tools.description: Unseal such a bundle into a profile.

tools.name: credential.list
tools.description: Which platforms a profile can log into. Account names, never secrets.

tools.name: group.list
tools.description: The groups profiles are labelled with.

tools.name: profile.batch
tools.description: Start, stop, delete, or reassign a proxy or extensions across many profiles.

tools.name: preset.instantiate
tools.description: Make a fleet from a template: N profiles, each with its own identity.

tools.name: task.list
tools.description: What is outstanding on a profile.

tools.name: task.add
tools.description: Put work on a profile's list, for now or for later.

tools.name: task.start
tools.description: Mark a task as being worked on.

tools.name: task.done
tools.description: Close a task, with what came of it.

tools.name: task.cancel
tools.description: Drop a task that no longer applies.

tools.name: proxy.list
tools.description: The proxy pool. Never credentials.

tools.name: extension.list
tools.description: The extension library, and what each profile loads.

tools.name: preset.list
tools.description: The stored templates.

tools.name: group.create
tools.description: Create a group.

tools.name: group.delete
tools.description: Delete a group. Its profiles stay.

tools.name: credential_fill
tools.description: Sign in with this profile's stored login. The agent never receives it.

tools.name: credential_new
tools.description: Sign up: the daemon draws the password, stores it, and types it.

tools.name: credential_store
tools.description: Put a login the profile already has into the vault.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: The profile's confirmation codes, by mail or by text.

tools.name: inbox_open_link
tools.description: Open a link out of a message, by its number. The address is never shown.
